title: Austin Good Vibes E-Bike Tours
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Children ages 5-11 can join the tour as passengers riding behind an adult driver, provided they are at least 3'6" tall. Our e-bikes feature passenger foot pegs and extra-long seats designed to safely and comfortably accommodate both a driver and passenger.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our tours have 100% 5 star reviews on Tripadvisor, Google and Airbnb. 

Whether for a regular group, custom private tour or corporate team building, Good Vibes Tours always delivers an unforgettable experience.

Welcome to Good Vibes Tours! We're all about radiating positivity, creating joyous, eco-friendly adventures that explore the beauty and vibrant culture of our beloved city.

Discover Austin's rich heritage, thriving arts scene, and culinary delights. Our expert guides weave an immersive narrative that connects you to local life beyond the traditional tourist path. We're not just about seeing Austin, we're about experiencing it. 

With Good Vibes Tours, every ride is infused with positivity and passion, creating experiences that excite and leave lasting memories. 

Get ready for an extraordinary journey through Austin, Texas. Your electric bike adventure, filled with good vibes, awaits!
